expectations.text: The agent inspects the repo for stack, test runner, and existing linters before asking anything
expectations.evidence: Before asking, the agent ran ls for package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Cargo.toml, CI, and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, and ran a Glob. It found the directory empty and said so.

expectations.text: No more than four questions are asked, and each one carries a usable default
expectations.evidence: It asked one question (what are you building, and in what language). It carried a default guess (TypeScript web app) and a fallback (a floor-only CONSTRAINTS.md).

expectations.text: When the user has no target number, the agent proposes recording today's value and holding it rather than inventing a threshold
expectations.evidence: The agent did say it would measure where the project is and hold that line. But it also proposed a fixed number with no measurement behind it: 'Coverage, for example, will be 80% on changed lines'. That is an invented threshold. The user never said they lack a target.

expectations.text: The resulting constraints say where each check runs, keeping fast checks in the edit loop and slow checks later
expectations.evidence: No constraints were written in this transcript. The agent never discussed which checks run in the edit loop and which run later.

expectations.text: Every number written down is accompanied by a reason
expectations.evidence: The only number mentioned was 80% coverage on changed lines, given with no reason. Nothing was written to a file.
